  3. Remote IT support

Remote IT support, scheduled around you and started only with your permission

Describe the problem, pick a time, and we work through it together on your screen. No unattended access, and we never ask for your passwords.

Request IT supportSee support plans

Problems we can usually fix remotely

If the computer turns on and can reach the internet, many problems can be solved without anyone visiting or shipping the device.

Software errors

Programs that crash, freeze, will not open, or show error messages.

Slow performance

Start-up programs, storage clean-up, updates, and background processes.

System configuration

Settings, user accounts, display, sound, backups, and default apps.

Windows support

Windows Update problems, drivers, and common Windows errors.

macOS support

System settings, updates, storage, and app issues on a Mac.

Connectivity issues

Wi-Fi drops, network settings, email setup, and printer connections.

See common Windows and macOS issues

How a support request works

Five steps from your first message to a confirmed fix.

  1. Submit a request

    Use the support form to tell us your device, operating system, and what is going wrong.

  2. Explain the problem

    We may ask a few follow-up questions, or for a screenshot of the error.

  3. Schedule a session

    We agree a time that suits you. Sessions are scheduled, not round the clock.

  4. Receive assistance

    You start the remote session, watch every step, and can end it at any time.

  5. Confirm resolution

    We check the problem is gone and explain what was changed.

Privacy and session authorization

Giving someone access to your computer requires trust. These rules apply to every remote session.

  • You start every session. We send a session code; nothing connects until you approve it on your own screen.
  • You can watch and stop at any time. Closing the session ends our access immediately.
  • No unattended access. We do not install tools that let us connect later without you.
  • We never ask for your passwords through forms, email, or chat. If a step needs one, you type it yourself.
  • We only open what the problem requires and tell you before looking at anything else.
  • Reputable remote support software is used for every session. Name of the remote support tool Jemawe uses (placeholder, not yet confirmed)

When remote support is not the right fit

Some problems need hands on the hardware. If the computer will not power on, has physical damage, or a failing part, remote support cannot fix it. In those cases we will tell you so and suggest a repair booking instead of charging for a session that cannot help.

Remote support also requires the computer to start and connect to the internet.

Describe the problem and pick a time

Most requests start with a short form. We reply to confirm the details and schedule your session.
